z-m-40-07.title: Idan muka ɗaga layin kwance, shin maki haɗuwa suna ƙaruwa ne kawai?
z-m-40-07.topic: Jadawalin aikin quadratic mai cikakkiyar ƙima y=|x²−4| da yadda adadin haɗuwarsa da layin kwance yake canzawa.
z-m-40-07.goal: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa adadin maki haɗuwa ba ya ci gaba da ƙaruwa kawai, amma yake canzawa yayin da tsayin layin kwance k yake canzawa; haɗa bayaninka da siffar jadawali (ƙoli mai naɗewa da maki da ya taɓa axis x).
z-m-40-07.material: Adadin maki da jadawalin aikin y = |x² − 4| (ana karantawa “cikakkiyar ƙimar x murabba’i a cire 4”) yake haɗuwa da layin kwance y = k ya yi daidai da adadin tushen ainihi dabam-dabam na daidaiton |x² − 4| = k. Ga ƙimomin y da aka lissafta ga wasu ƙimomin x. Idan x ya kasance −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, y kuwa ya kasance 5, 0, 3, 4, 3, 0, 5.
z-m-40-07.thinking.0: Yi hasashe, bincika shi ta lissafi, sannan ka gyara shi.
z-m-40-07.thinking.1: Nemo ƙimomin k da suke matsayin iyaka.
z-m-40-07.thinking.2: Haɗa siffar jadawali da adadin tushen daidaito.
z-m-40-07.prereq.0: Matakin H3 yana nuna wahala ne kawai a wannan rabon aikin, ba yana nufin tsarin karatu ya sanya wannan abun cikin a wani aji ba. Zato: ka riga ka san jadawalin aikin quadratic, ma’anar cikakkiyar ƙima, da fassarar cewa tushen ainihin daidaito maki ne na haɗuwar jadawali da layin kwance.
z-m-40-07.prereq.1: Tushen daidaiton quadratic x² = m (biyu idan m > 0, guda ɗaya idan m = 0, babu idan m < 0).
z-m-40-07.prereq.2: Cikakkiyar ƙima |t| ita ce t idan t ≥ 0, kuma −t idan t < 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai yayin da k yake canzawa. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi adadin maki haɗuwa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bi ƙimomin jadawalin, sannan ka ƙirga sau nawa jadawalin yake ratsa matsayin y = k, tazara ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.1: Raba shi zuwa daidaito biyu x² − 4 = k da x² − 4 = −k, sannan ka ƙayyade adadin x da kowannensu yake samarwa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Da farko, zana layin kwance y = 1, inda k = 1.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maki dabam-dabam nawa ne layin kwance y = 1 yake da su tare da jadawalin?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.after: |x² − 4| = 1 yana nufin x² − 4 = 1 ko x² − 4 = −1, saboda haka x² = 5 ko x² = 3. x = ±√5, ±√3, wato maki 4 ne. A jadawali, ƙimomi suna raguwa daga x = 1 (y = 3) zuwa x = 2 (y = 0), sannan suna ƙaruwa daga x = 2 zuwa x = 3 (y = 5); saboda haka a gefen dama yana ratsa y = 1 sau biyu, gefen hagu kuma haka yake.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa yana haɗuwa sau ɗaya ne a kowane gefen hagu da dama, kamar parabola.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan tunani ne cewa idan aka bi siffar ƙimomin jadawalin suna raguwa sannan su ƙaru, zai ratsa sau biyu a kowane gefen hagu da dama.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan tunani ne cewa saboda siffar da ta taɓa axis x, ana ƙara wani maki guda.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa tunda babu x mai y = 1 a jadawalin, ba sa haɗuwa. Ka yi tunani game da ƙimomin da ke tsakanin wuraren jadawalin.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.info: A wannan karon, zana layin kwance y = 4, inda k = 4. A jadawalin, y = 4 idan x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Maki dabam-dabam nawa ne layin kwance y = 4 yake da su tare da jadawalin?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Daga x² − 4 = 4, x = ±2√2 (maki 2), sannan daga x² − 4 = −4, x = 0 (maki 1), kuma ba su haɗu ba, don haka jimilla 3 ne. k = 4 shi ne tsayin kololuwar ɓangaren da ya lanƙwashe zuwa sama a x = 0, don haka layin kwance ya taɓa kololuwar kawai.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa adadin ya kasance iri ɗaya ko da k ya canza.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan tunani ya kasa lura da taɓawa sau ɗaya a x = 0, yana ƙirga maki biyu na waje kawai.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan tunani yana ƙirga wurin taɓawa ɗaya a x = 0 tare da maki biyu na waje.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa saboda k ya ƙaru, mahaɗuwar layukan ma za su ƙaru.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.info: A ƙarshe, zana layin kwance y = 5 tare da k = 5.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Maki daban-daban nawa ne layin kwance y = 5 yake da su tare da zanen?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Daga x² − 4 = 5, x = ±3 (maki 2), kuma x² − 4 = −5 yana nufin x² = −1, wanda ba shi da tushen gaske. Jimilla 2 ne. Idan k ya fi 4 girma, layin kwance ya haura kololuwar da ta lanƙwashe, sai rassan biyu na waje kawai suka rage.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa yayin da aka ɗaga k sama, yawan mahaɗuwar layukan yana ƙaruwa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan tunani ne da ya ɗauko adadin daga lokacin da k = 4.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan tunani ne cewa da zarar ya haura tsayin kololuwa 4, ba za su sake haɗuwa ba. Duba ko akwai x mai y = 5 a jadawalin.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa da zarar ya haura kololuwar da ta lanƙwashe, wurare biyu na waje kawai zai taɓa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.reflect: Shin ka yi tunanin mahaɗuwar layukan tana ƙaruwa ne kawai yayin da k ke tashi? Bayyana dalilin da ya sa idan an ɗaga k daga ƙaramin ƙima sosai, adadin mahaɗuwar ke canzawa 0 → 2 → 4 → 3 → 2, kana danganta hakan da wuraren da zanen yake taɓa axis x da kuma kololuwar da ta lanƙwashe.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.prompt: Yayin da ake ɗaga k a hankali daga ƙaramin lambar mara kyau sosai, rubuta duk ƙimomin iyaka na k inda adadin mahaɗuwar ke canzawa, sannan ka bayyana wane ɓangaren zanen layin kwance ke ratsawa a kowace iyaka.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.0: A jadawalin, nemo mafi ƙarancin ƙimar y da tsayin ɓangaren lanƙwashe kusa da x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sanya k kusa ƙasa da kuma sama da iyaka, sannan ka kwatanta adadin mahaɗuwar.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Iyakokin su ne k = ... da ...
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙimomin k na iyaka su ne waɗannan, da kuma tsayin wane maki ne?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: A kusa da kowace iyaka (idan k ya yi ƙasa da ita da idan ya fi ta girma), ka faɗi adadin mahaɗuwar?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.0: Iyakokin su ne k=0 da k=4. k=0 shi ne tsayin x=±2, inda layin kwance ya taɓa axis x; idan ya haura wannan, mahaɗuwa 4 ne. k=4 shi ne tsayin kololuwar da ta lanƙwashe a x=0, don haka a nan mahaɗuwa 3 ne; idan ya fi 4, mahaɗuwa 2 kawai suka rage.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.1: Idan aka ɗaga layin kwance, da farko yana taɓa zanen a k=0 (mahaɗuwa 2), tsakanin 0 da 4 akwai 4, a k=4 ya ratsa kololuwa a x=0 kuma akwai 3, idan k ya fi 4 kuma wurare biyu na waje kawai yake haɗuwa da su, wato 2. Don haka ƙimomin da ke kawo canjin su ne 0 da 4.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa ce da ta haɗa yanayin maki 0 ma idan k < 0.

z-m-40-04.thinking.2: Nemo ƙimomi da dama da suka cika sharadi.
z-m-40-04.title: A tafiyar zuwa da dawowa, gudun tafiyar dawowa nawa ne ya zama dole domin samun matsakaicin gudu?
z-m-40-04.topic: Matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa da aka bayyana da aikin kaso: yadda yake canjawa bisa gudun dawowa, da iyakarsa
z-m-40-04.goal: Yi amfani da lokuta domin tabbatar da cewa matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa ba matsakaicin lissafi na gudun biyu ba ne; duba iyakar matsakaicin gudun ko da an ƙara gudun dawowa ta hanyar hasashe da lissafi; sannan ka nemo gudun da ke cika sharadi da kanka.
z-m-40-04.material: Bas yana yin tafiya zuwa da dawowa a kan hanya ɗaya. A tafiyar zuwa yana tafiya da gudu tsayayye na 30 km a kowace awa, dawowa kuma da gudu tsayayye na x km a kowace awa. Ba a san nisan tafiya ta hanya ɗaya D km ba, kuma babu tsayawa a hanya. An ayyana matsakaicin gudu da (jimillar nisan da aka yi) ÷ (jimillar lokacin da aka ɗauka).
z-m-40-04.thinking.0: Sake duba hasashen farko bisa sabon bayani
z-m-40-04.thinking.1: Karanta yanayin canjin (babba da farko, sannan ƙaramar ƙari a hankali)
z-m-40-04.prereq.0: Matakin H3 alamar wahala ce kawai a tsarin rarraba wannan rukuni, ba yana nufin tsarin karatu ya sanya wannan batu a wani aji ba. Zato: ka riga ka san gudu = nisa ÷ lokaci da yadda ake lissafi da furucin kaso.
z-m-40-04.prereq.1: Lissafi da furucin rabo (kaso), da fahimtar cewa kaso yana raguwa yayin da ma'aunin rabawa ke ƙaruwa
z-m-40-04.prereq.2: Ƙa'idar cewa matsakaicin gudu = jimillar nisa ÷ jimillar lokacin da aka ɗauka
z-m-40-04.s.s1.prompt: Za a bayyana bayanin kashi-kashi. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi abin da matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa zai kasance.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sanya nisan tafiya ta hanya ɗaya a wata ƙima ta musamman kamar 60 km, sannan ka nemo lokacin tafiyar zuwa da na dawowa dabam-dabam.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bayan nemo nisan tafiya-da-dawowa da jimillar lokaci, gwada ko sakamakon yana canjawa idan ka sauya nisan hanya ɗaya zuwa wata ƙima.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.info: A ɗauki ranar da gudun dawowa yake 60 km a kowace awa a matsayin misali. Har yanzu ba a san nisan hanya ɗaya D ba.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Matsakaicin gudun tafiya-da-dawowa a wannan rana nawa ne?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan D = 60 km ne, tafiyar zuwa tana ɗaukar 60 ÷ 30 = awa 2, dawowa kuma 60 ÷ 60 = awa 1, saboda haka tafiya-da-dawowa mai nisan 120 km ta ɗauki awa 3. Matsakaicin gudu shi ne 120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h. Ana samun sakamako iri ɗaya ga sauran ƙimomin D (D yana soke kansa). Ya gaza 45 domin an fi ɗaukar lokaci ana tafiya da gudu a hankali.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan tunanin ya ɗauki matsakaicin lissafin gudun (tsakiyar 30 da 60) a matsayin matsakaicin gudu.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ƙasa da 45 km a kowace awa
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan tunanin ya yi la'akari da cewa an fi ɗaukar lokaci ana tafiya da gudu a hankali.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Fiye da 45 km a kowace awa
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan tunanin ya ɗauka cewa ɓangaren da ya fi sauri yana da tasiri mafi girma. Kwatanta lokacin da aka ɗauka a kowane ɓangare.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba mu san D ba, saboda haka ba za mu san matsakaicin gudu ba
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan tunanin ya ɗauka cewa ana iya lissafi ne kawai idan an san takamaiman nisa. Gwada sanya D = 60 sannan ka kwatanta da wasu ƙimomi.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Duba ranar da aka ƙara gudun dawowa zuwa 120 km a kowace awa.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Gudun dawowa ya ninku (60 → 120). Yaya matsakaicin gudu zai canja daga 40 km/h?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan D = 120 km ne, tafiyar zuwa tana ɗaukar awa 4, dawowa kuma awa 1, saboda haka jimillar nisa da lokaci ta ba da 240 ÷ 5 = 48 km/h. Ko da an ninka gudun, matsakaicin ya ƙaru da kashi 20% kawai. Dalili kuwa shi ne lokacin tafiyar zuwa bai canja ba, saboda haka jimillar lokacin ba ta ragu da rabi ba.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yana ƙaruwa har ya kusan ninka, ya kusan kai 80 km/h.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa idan saurin dawowa ya ninka, matsakaicin sauri ma yana ninka daidai gwargwado.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Matsakaicin sauri kusan ba ya canzawa, yana nan kusa da 40.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan tunani ne cewa canjin saurin dawowa kusan ba ya shafar matsakaicin sauri.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yana ƙaruwa daga 40 amma bai kai ninkawa ba.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne da ya yi la’akari da cewa lokacin tafiya zuwa can yana nan iri ɗaya.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ya zama 30 km/h, iri ɗaya da saurin tafiya zuwa can.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa ɓangaren da aka yi da sauri yana soke kansa a matsakaici.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ko da an ƙara saurin dawowa zuwa 300 km/h, matsakaicin saurin tafiyar zuwa da dawowa kusan 54.5 km/h ne.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan muka ɗauka za a iya ƙara saurin dawowa yadda ake so, shin zai yiwu matsakaicin saurin tafiyar zuwa da dawowa ya kai 60 km/h?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Matsakaicin sauri shi ne 60x ÷ (30 + x). An riga an yi amfani da lokacin tafiya zuwa can, don haka ko da lokacin dawowa ya kusan zama 0, matsakaicin yana kusantar 2D ÷ (D/30) = 60 ne kawai, ba ya kaiwa. Idan x = 150, yana 50; idan 300, kusan 54.5; idan 600, kusan 57.1.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Idan ka yi saurin dawowa sosai, daga ƙarshe za ka iya kaiwa gare shi.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa idan an ƙara sauri, matsakaicin ma yana ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Idan saurin dawowa ya zama 90 km/h, matsakaicin ya zama daidai 60.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan tunani ne cewa zai yi daidai a wani takamaiman sauri. Ka lissafta matsakaicin idan saurin 90 km/h ne.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Akwai lokacin da ya kai 60; kawai ba abu ne mai yiwuwa a zahiri ba.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan tunani ne da ya ɗauki ƙimar iyaka kamar ƙimar da za a iya kaiwa. Lissafa tsawon lokacin da tafiyar za ta ɗauka domin matsakaicin ya zama 60.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ba za a iya kaiwa gare shi ba. Yana kusantar 60 ne kawai.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan tunani ne da ya yi la’akari da cewa lokacin tafiya zuwa can tuni an kayyade shi.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko wataƙila ka ɗauki matsakaicin sauri a matsayin matsakaicin saurin gudu (45). Wane bayani (lokacin tafiya) ne ya canza tunaninka? Bayyana siffar yadda matsakaici yake ƙaruwa yayin da kake ƙara saurin dawowa (yana ƙaruwa sosai a farko, sannan ƙarin yana raguwa) da dalilin da ya sa iyakar 60 take bayyana.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi saurin dawowa x (km a cikin awa ɗaya) domin matsakaicin saurin tafiyar zuwa da dawowa ya kasance daga 50 km/h zuwa 55 km/h, sannan nemo ƙimomin x guda 3 dabam-dabam. x cikakkiyar lamba ce mai kyau, kuma saurin tafiya zuwa can 30 km/h ne.

z-m-40-05.title: Aikin tushen murabba’i mai ƙarshen (−2, 1): shin akwai tsarin lissafi guda ɗaya kawai?
z-m-40-05.topic: Aikin tushen murabba’i y=√(ax+b)+c: ’yancin da ya rage idan aka kayyade tsarin lissafin da bayanin ƙarshen jadawali.
z-m-40-05.goal: Yanke hukunci kan adadin constants na aikin tushen murabba’i da bayanin ƙarshen guda ɗaya yake kayyade da waɗanda ya bari; ƙirƙiri tsarin lissafi dabam-dabam da suka cika sharadin da kanka, sannan ka bayyana ƙarin abin da ake bukata domin a kayyade lanƙwasar guda ɗaya tak.
z-m-40-05.material: A kan allon aji, jadawalin aikin tushen murabba’i y = √(ax + b) + c (ana karantawa “tushen murabba’in a x da b, sannan a ƙara c”) ya bayyana. Lanƙwasar tana da ƙarshenta na hagu a (−2, 1), sannan ta miƙe daga nan zuwa sama da dama. a, b, c constants ne; tun da lanƙwasar tana miƙe zuwa dama, a > 0. Ba a san sauran maki da lanƙwasar take ratsawa ba.
z-m-40-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri tsarin lissafi dabam-dabam da suka cika sharadin.
z-m-40-05.prereq.0: Matakin H3 da aka ware yana nuna wahala ne kawai a wannan rabon aikin, ba yana nufin tsarin karatu ya sanya wannan batu a wani aji na musamman ba. Zato: ka riga ka san cewa jadawalin aikin tushen murabba’i y = √(ax + b) + c yana farawa daga ƙarshen jadawali kuma ya miƙe zuwa gefe guda.
z-m-40-05.prereq.1: Lambobin da tushen murabba’insu cikakkiyar lamba ce (murabba’ai cikakku).
z-m-40-05.prereq.2: Lissafin neman ƙimar y ta hanyar saka x = k cikin tsarin lissafi.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.prompt: Shin zai yiwu a kayyade a, b, c kowannensu da ƙima guda ɗaya tak daga bayanin ƙarshen (−2, 1) kaɗai?
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunani game da ƙimar da dole ne ta kasance cikin tushen murabba’i idan ka saka maƙasudin x na ƙarshen jadawali, −2, cikin tsarin √(ax + b) + c.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirƙiri tsarin lissafi biyu masu ƙarshen iri ɗaya amma a dabam-dabam, sannan ka kwatanta ko jadawalinsu iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.a: An kayyade c amma a yana nan a buɗe, kuma b ana kayyade shi ta a.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne da ya binciki yadda bayanin ƙarshen jadawali yake haɗuwa da adadin constants.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.b: An kayyade: daga maƙasudan ƙarshen jadawali, b = −2, c = 1, kuma a = 1.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ne da ya canja maƙasudan ƙarshen kai tsaye zuwa constants. Idan ka saka x = −2 cikin furucin, za ka iya bincika ma’anar ƙarshen jadawali.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.c: Ba a kayyade ba: ana iya zaɓar a, b, c da ’yanci.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne cewa maki guda ɗaya ba ya sanya wani takura ga constants. Rubuta sharadin da ƙarshen jadawali yake ba wa tsarin lissafi.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.d: An kayyade: jadawalin yana ratsa ƙarshen, saboda haka an kayyade constants ukun kowannensu da ƙima guda ɗaya tak.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa sharadi guda ɗaya yana kayyade constants ukun duka. Ƙirƙiri tsarin lissafi biyu masu ƙarshen iri ɗaya, sannan ka kwatanta su.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.explain: Maƙasudin y na ƙarshen jadawali shi ne c, saboda haka c = 1. A ƙarshen jadawali ƙimar cikin tushen murabba’i 0 ce, don haka −2a + b = 0, wato b = 2a. Har yanzu ana iya zaɓar a, saboda haka kowane tsarin y = √(a(x + 2)) + 1 ɗan takara ne. Misali, idan a = 1, y = √(x + 2) + 1; idan a = 4, y = √(4x + 8) + 1.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.prompt: Daga y = √(ax + b) + c masu ƙarshen (−2, 1) kuma suke miƙewa zuwa dama, ƙirƙiri lanƙwasu dabam-dabam guda 3 waɗanda ƙimar y a x = −1 cikakkiyar lamba ce. a, b, c cikakkun lambobi ne kuma a ≤ 20.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunani game da ƙimar da dole ne ta kasance cikin tushen murabba’i a ƙarshen jadawali, sannan ka saka maƙasudan ƙarshen cikin tsarin lissafi.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da lambar da dole ne ta kasance cikin tushen murabba’i idan ka saka x = −1, domin tushen murabba’inta ya zama cikakkiyar lamba.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.var.a: a (coefficient na x da ke cikin tushen murabba’i)
z-m-40-05.s.s2.var.b: b (ƙimar dindindin da ke cikin tushen murabba’i)
z-m-40-05.s.s2.var.c: c (ƙimar dindindin da ke wajen tushen murabba’i)
z-m-40-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a, b, c cikakkun lambobi ne kuma 0 < a ≤ 20.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne a, b, c su zama cikakkun lambobi kuma 0 < a ≤ 20.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Maƙasudin y na ƙarshen jadawali shi ne 1.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne ka zaɓi constants domin maƙasudin y na ƙarshen jadawali ya zama 1.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Idan x = −2, ƙimar cikin tushen murabba’i 0 ce.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan x = −2, ƙimar cikin tushen murabba’i ba 0 ba ce. Daidaita shi domin ƙarshen jadawalin ya zama (−2, 1).
z-m-40-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Idan x = −1, ƙimar y cikakkiyar lamba ce.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Idan x = −1, ƙimar y ba cikakkiyar lamba ba ce.
z-m-40-05.s.s2.explain: Daga sharadin ƙarshen jadawali, b = 2a da c = 1, don haka y = √(a(x + 2)) + 1. Idan x = −1, y = √a + 1 ne, saboda haka yana zama cikakkiyar lamba ne kawai idan a murabba’i cikakke ne (1, 4, 9, 16). Ko da ƙarshen jadawali iri ɗaya ne, ƙimomin a dabam-dabam suna ba da lanƙwasu dabam-dabam (idan a ya fi girma, yana tashi da sauri).
z-m-40-05.s.s3.prompt: Minjun ya ce, “Idan ƙarshen jadawalin iri ɗaya ne, lanƙwasun biyun lanƙwasa ɗaya ce.” Ka yi amfani da tsarin lissafin biyun da ka ƙirƙira a sama a matsayin misalai, ka ba Minjun amsa, sannan ka rubuta ƙarin abin da ake bukata ban da ƙarshen jadawali domin a kayyade lanƙwasar guda ɗaya tak.
z-m-40-05.s.s3.hint.0: Saka x iri ɗaya (misali −1) cikin tsarin lissafin biyun, sannan ka kwatanta y.
z-m-40-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da constant ɗin da bayanin wani ƙarin maki da lanƙwasar take ratsawa yake kayyade.
z-m-40-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka nuna da lambobi dalilin da ya sa tsarin lissafi biyun da ka bayar suke da ƙarshen iri ɗaya amma lanƙwasu dabam-dabam?
z-m-40-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: An fahimci cewa “bayanin da ake bukata” shi ne bayanin da yake kayyade ƙimar a?
z-m-40-05.s.s3.model.0: A’a. Ko da ƙarshen jadawalin iri ɗaya ne, (−2, 1), tsarin y = √(x+2)+1 da y = √(4x+8)+1 suna da ƙimomi 2 da 3 a x = −1, saboda haka lanƙwasu dabam-dabam ne. Domin a kayyade lanƙwasar guda ɗaya tak, ban da ƙarshen jadawali muna bukatar wani maki da lanƙwasar take ratsawa.
z-m-40-05.s.s3.model.1: Bayanin ƙarshen jadawali kaɗai bai wadatar ba. Idan a = 1, lanƙwasar a hankali take hawa; idan a = 9, tana hawa da sauri sosai, duk da cewa ƙarshensu (−2, 1) ne. Muna bukatar bayanin da yake nuna ƙimar a, misali wani maki da lanƙwasar take ratsawa.
z-m-40-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ba a yi amfani da takamaiman ƙimar wani maki ba, amma an nuna ainihin bayanin da ake bukata.

z-m-40-12.title: Saƙon '1/x aiki ne mai raguwa': ya dace a aika shi haka nan?
z-m-40-12.topic: Ƙaruwa da raguwa na aikin akasin rabo y=1/x: bayyanawa ta hanyar raba zuwa tazara
z-m-40-12.goal: Yi amfani da misalin karya domin nuna cewa y = 1/x yana raguwa a ɓangaren tabbatacce da mara kyau dabam-dabam, amma ba za a ce yana raguwa ga duk x ≠ 0 ba; sannan ka sake rubuta saƙon da za a aika wa ƙaramin ɗalibi ta hanyar raba zuwa tazara.
z-m-40-12.material: Wani babban ɗalibi yana son aika saƙon da ke ƙasa game da aikin y = 1/x (x ≠ 0) ga ƙaramin ɗalibi. (Ana karantawa: 'y daidai da 1 bisa x'.) 'Mai raguwa' na nufin idan x1 < x2, to koyaushe f(x1) > f(x2).
z-m-40-12.thinking.0: Nemo gama-garin da'awar da ta wuce gona da iri a saƙon
z-m-40-12.thinking.2: Sake rubuta ta yadda za ta dace da wanda zai karanta
z-m-40-12.prereq.0: Matakin H3 alamar wahala ce kawai a tsarin rarraba wannan rukuni, ba yana nufin tsarin karatu ya sanya wannan batu a wani aji ba. Zato: ka riga ka san ma'anar ayyukan ƙaruwa da raguwa (yana raguwa idan f(x1) > f(x2) yayin x1 < x2) da yadda ake lissafa ƙimar kaso 1/x.
z-m-40-12.prereq.1: Lissafin cewa akasin lambar mara kyau ma lamba ce mara kyau
z-m-40-12.prereq.2: Ma'anar tazara (ɓangaren tabbatacce da ɓangaren mara kyau)
z-m-40-12.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin saƙon babban ɗalibin da ya yi kuskure.
z-m-40-12.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta waɗanne x ake kwatantawa da juna a kowane layi.
z-m-40-12.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi lambobi biyu x1 < x2, har da waɗanda alamunsu suka bambanta, sannan ka saka su kai tsaye cikin da'awar kowane layi.
z-m-40-12.s.s1.line.0: Ga y = 1/x, idan x = 1, 2, 4, to y = 1, 1/2, 1/4; yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, y yana raguwa.
z-m-40-12.s.s1.line.1: Haka kuma idan x = −4, −2, −1, to y = −1/4, −1/2, −1; yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, y yana raguwa.
z-m-40-12.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka idan x1 < x2, koyaushe 1/x1 > 1/x2 ne, kuma wannan aiki yana raguwa ga duk lambobin ainihi masu x ≠ 0.
z-m-40-12.s.s1.explain: Kuskuren yana layi na 3. Layuka 1 da 2 suna kwatanta tabbatattu da tabbatattu, da marasa kyau da marasa kyau, saboda haka daidai ne. Amma idan x1 = −1 kuma x2 = 1, to 1/x1 = −1 < 1 = 1/x2; x ya ƙaru kuma y ma ya ƙaru. Ba a gwada kwatancen da suka haye daga ɓangaren tabbatacce zuwa mara kyau ba.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.prompt: Gina misalan karya da ke nuna cewa kalmar 'koyaushe' a layi na 3 ba daidai ba ce. Nemo nau'i-nau'i 3 daban-daban (x1, x2) masu x1 < x2 da 1/x1 < 1/x2. x1 da x2 lambobi ne marasa sifili.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.hint.0: Canja alamun x1 da x2, sannan ka kwatanta alamomi da girman 1/x1 da 1/x2.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.hint.1: Yayin samar da nau'i-nau'i ukun, duba ko duk sakamakon suna da haɗin alamomi iri ɗaya.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Babu ɗaya daga cikin lambobin da yake 0.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.fail.c1: x1 da x2 ba za su zama 0 ba.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne x1 ya gaza x2.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.ok.c3: x ya ƙaru kuma 1/x ma ya ƙaru. Wannan misali ne na karya.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.fail.c3: A cikin wannan nau'i-nau'i, yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, 1/x yana raguwa ko ya tsaya iri ɗaya. Ba misalin karya ba ne.
z-m-40-12.s.s2.explain: Domin 1/x1 < 1/x2, dole ne x1 ya zama mara kyau kuma x2 tabbatacce (x1 < 0 < x2). Idan x mara kyau ne, 1/x ma mara kyau ne; idan tabbatacce ne, shi ma tabbatacce ne, saboda haka a wurin sauyin alama ƙimar y tana tsalle zuwa sama.
z-m-40-12.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta saƙon da za a aika wa ƙaramin ɗalibin cikin jimloli ɗaya ko biyu. Ka kuma haɗa kewayon da za a iya cewa aikin yana raguwa a cikinsa.
z-m-40-12.s.s3.hint.0: Raba zuwa ɓangaren tabbatacce da mara kyau, sannan ka rubuta jimla ɗaya kan abin da ke faruwa da y idan x ya ƙaru a kowane ɓangare.
z-m-40-12.s.s3.hint.1: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin nau'i-nau'in misalan karya da ka ƙirƙira sannan ka saka shi cikin saƙon.
z-m-40-12.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: y = 1/x, a tazarar ... da kuma a tazarar ... dabam-dabam, ...
z-m-40-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Domin ƙaramin ɗalibin kada ya fahimce ta a matsayin 'koyaushe tana raguwa', ka rubuta tare da ita iyakar inda take daidai da inda ta daina?
z-m-40-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka lissafa kuma ka tabbatar cewa misalin lambobin da ka bayar da gaske yanayi ne da x da y duka suka ƙaru?
z-m-40-12.s.s3.model.0: y=1/x yana raguwa a tazarar x>0 da kuma tazarar x<0 dabam-dabam, amma ba za mu ce yana raguwa a duk yankin ba. Idan x=−1, y=−1; idan x=1, y=1, saboda haka x ya ƙaru kuma y ma ya ƙaru.
z-m-40-12.s.s3.model.1: Idan ka kwatanta tabbatattu da tabbatattu, da marasa kyau da marasa kyau, y yana raguwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa; saboda haka aikin yana raguwa a kowace tazara. Amma daga −2 zuwa 3, y yana ƙaruwa daga −1/2 zuwa 1/3, saboda haka kada mu rubuta cewa yana raguwa ga duk x≠0.

z-m-40-08.title: Idan mun san f(1) = f(5) kawai, shin aikin quadratic na musamman ne?
z-m-40-08.topic: Daidaiton ayyukan quadratic: abin da f(1)=f(5) ke nunawa da ’yancin da ya rage.
z-m-40-08.goal: Fahimci cewa maki biyu masu ƙimar aiki iri ɗaya suna ƙayyade axis ɗin daidaito na aikin quadratic kawai, ba aikin gaba ɗaya ba; tabbatar da cewa ko da an ƙara wasu sharudda ba lallai aikin ya zama na musamman ba, kuma bambanta sharuddan da ke kawo sabon bayani da waɗanda ba sa kawo shi.
z-m-40-08.material: Game da aikin quadratic f(x) = ax² + bx + c (a ≠ 0), abin da aka sani kawai shi ne f(1) = f(5). (Karanta: 'f na 1 da f na 5 sun yi daidai'.) Seonwoo ya ce, “Akwai maki biyu masu ƙima iri ɗaya, saboda haka an ƙayyade f ta hanya guda.”
z-m-40-08.thinking.0: Bambanta abin da bayanin da aka bayar ya ƙayyade da abin da bai ƙayyade ba.
z-m-40-08.thinking.1: Gina ayyuka da dama da suka cika sharadin.
z-m-40-08.thinking.2: Bambanta sabon bayani da bayanin da aka riga aka haɗa.
z-m-40-08.prereq.0: Matsayin H3 da aka sanya lakabin wahala ne kawai a wannan rarrabawar samarwa, kuma ba ya nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan abun cikin wani aji na musamman. Zato: ka riga ka san daidaiton hagu da dama na zanen aikin quadratic da tsarin f(x) = a(x − p)² + q.
z-m-40-08.prereq.2: Kasancewar maki biyu masu tsayi iri ɗaya suna da tazara iri ɗaya daga axis ɗin daidaito.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.prompt: Me za a iya faɗa tabbatacce daga f(1) = f(5)?
z-m-40-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ka gina ayyukan quadratic biyu da suka cika f(1) = f(5) da kanka, sannan ka gwada ta hanyar saka ƙimomi.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.hint.1: A kan zanen ayyukan biyu da ka ƙirƙira, rubuta dabam abin da yake iri ɗaya da wanda ya bambanta.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.o.a: Za mu iya sanin y-coordinate na kololuwar zanen.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani yana ɗaukar sanin axis ɗin daidaito da sanin tsayin kololuwa a matsayin abu ɗaya. Gina ayyukan da tsayinsu ya bambanta.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ya gauraya abubuwa, yana ɗaukar ƙimar a tsakiyar x na maki biyun a matsayin 0. Tsakiyar ita ce axis ɗin daidaito, ba tushen aiki ba.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.o.c: Axis ɗin daidaito na zanen shi ne x = 3.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne da ya karanta axis ɗin daidaito daga wuraren maki biyun masu ƙima iri ɗaya.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.o.d: Za mu iya sanin ƙimar a.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa daidaito shi kaɗai yana kuma ƙayyade faɗin zanen. Ka gina aiki mai wani a daban da kanka.
z-m-40-08.s.s1.explain: Zanen aikin quadratic yana daidaita hagu da dama game da axis ɗin daidaito, don haka x-coordinate na maki biyu masu ƙima iri ɗaya suna da tazara iri ɗaya daga axis. Saboda haka axis ɗin x = 3 ne, daidai a tsakiyar x biyun. Amma ba za mu iya sanin tsayin kololuwa ko faɗin a ba.
z-m-40-08.s.s2.prompt: Mun kuma koyi cewa f(0) = 5. Ta rubuta f(x) = a(x − 3)² + q, nemo ma'aurata (a, q) guda 3 na lambobi cikakku daban-daban da suka cika f(1) = f(5) da f(0) = 5 kuma suna da ƙaramin ƙima (a > 0). (a ≤ 5)
z-m-40-08.s.s2.hint.0: Lissafa f(0) = a(0 − 3)² + q sannan ka fara rubuta alaƙar da ke tsakanin a da q.
z-m-40-08.s.s2.hint.1: Saka ƙimomi kamar 1, 2, 3 a matsayin a domin nemo q, sannan ka tabbatar da cewa sharuddan a ≤ 5 da a > 0 sun cika.
z-m-40-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a lamba cikakkiya ce mai kyau wadda ba ta fi 5 ba, kuma q lamba cikakkiya ce.
z-m-40-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne a ya zama lamba cikakkiya mai kyau wadda ba ta fi 5 ba, kuma q ya zama lamba cikakkiya.
z-m-40-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Daidaita a da q domin f(0) = a(0 − 3)² + q = 5.
z-m-40-08.s.s2.explain: f(0) = 9a + q = 5, don haka q = 5 − 9a. Duk lokacin da ka canja a, wani aiki daban zai samu (idan a = 1 to q = −4; idan a = 2 to q = −13, ...). Ko da mun san axis ɗin daidaito da maki guda ɗaya, har yanzu ba a ƙayyade aikin ta hanya guda ba.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.prompt: Baya ga f(1) = f(5) da f(0) = 5 da muka sani zuwa yanzu, zaɓi duk bayanan da ke taimakawa wajen ƙayyade f ta hanya guda.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.hint.0: Saka kowane bayani cikin f(x) = a(x − 3)² + q, sannan ka rubuta ko sabon lissafi tsakanin a da q ya samu.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ko sabon lissafin ya bambanta da wanda aka samu daga f(0) = 5 ko kuwa iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa idan an san tsayin kololuwa, alaƙar da ke tsakanin a da q tana ƙayyade komai ta hanya guda.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.r.b: Wannan tunani ya kasa lura cewa 6 yana daidaita da 0, yana ɗaukar hakan a matsayin sabon bayani.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.r.c: Wannan tunani ne cewa ƙimar wani sabon maki nesa da axis tana ƙara wata alaƙa.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.r.d: Wannan tunani ne da ya ɗauki maimaita daidaiton da aka riga aka sani a matsayin sabon bayani.
z-m-40-08.s.s3.explain: Axis ɗin daidaito x = 3 ne, don haka f(6) = f(0) da f(2) = f(4) abubuwa ne da suka riga suka tabbata, ba sabon bayani ba ne. Ƙaramin ƙima −4 yana ba da q = −4, saboda haka a = 1; kuma f(4) = −3 yana ba da a + q = −3, wanda tare da 9a + q = 5 ya ƙayyade a = 1 da q = −4.

z-m-40-02.title: A maganin da aka rubuta aikin juyawa, wane ne layin farko da ya yi kuskure?

z-m-40-02.s.s1.line.2: Daga y ≥ 2, muna da y − 2 ≥ 0, saboda haka y − 2 = √(x + 3).
z-m-40-02.s.s1.line.4: Don haka aikin juyawa na f shi ne g(x) = √(x + 3) − 2.
z-m-40-02.s.s1.explain: Kuskuren yana farawa a layi na 4. A cikin y − 2 = √(x + 3), matsar da −2 zuwa ɓangaren dama yana mai da shi +2, saboda haka ya kamata ya zama y = 2 + √(x + 3). Layi na 5 ya ci gaba da wannan kuskure kamar yadda yake. Layuka 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne.
z-m-40-02.s.s2.prompt: Muna son gwada ko g(x) = √(x + 3) − 2 da Haeun ta samo aikin juyawa ne da gaske na f. Wane gwaji ne ya fi nuna matsalar kai tsaye?
z-m-40-02.s.s2.hint.0: Saka ƙimar x guda ɗaya (misali 3) cikin ƙa'idar f, sannan ka fara nemo y.

z-m-40-02.s.s2.o.a: Nemo g(3), sannan ka kwatanta ko ƙimar daidai take da f(3)
z-m-40-02.s.s2.r.a: Wannan tunanin ya ɗauki aikin juyawa a matsayin aiki da ke bayar da ƙima iri ɗaya da f. Aikin juyawa yana ɗaukar fitarwar f a matsayin shigarsa.

z-m-40-02.s.s2.o.c: Kafa kuma warware ma'aunin don ganin ko akwai x da f(x) = g(x)
z-m-40-02.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunanin ya ɗauki wuraren da f da g suka haɗu a matsayin shaida cewa suna aikin juyawa ne. Wuraren haɗuwar ba su da alaƙa kai tsaye da dangantakar juyawa.
z-m-40-02.s.s2.o.d: Nemo f(3), sannan ka saka wannan ƙima cikin g ka duba ko an sami 3
z-m-40-02.s.s2.r.d: Wannan tunanin yana gwada da ƙimomi gaskiyar cewa ayyukan juyawa suna warware juna.
z-m-40-02.s.s2.explain: Ga aikin juyawa g, idan f(x) = y, dole ne g(y) = x ya cika. f(3) = −2, amma g(−2) = √1 − 2 = −1, ba 3 ba. Idan aka yi amfani da daidai g(x) = 2 + √(x + 3), to g(−2) = 2 + 1 = 3.

z-m-40-01.title: Mu zaɓi yanki domin aikin juyawa ya wanzu.
z-m-40-01.topic: Daidaiton ɗaya-da-ɗaya da ayyukan juyawa: rage yankin zuwa tazara domin f(x)=x²−2x ya sami aikin juyawa.
z-m-40-01.goal: Fahimci cewa jadawalin da ke duba wasu ƙimomi kaɗan ba hujja ba ce ta “ɗaya-da-ɗaya”; tsara tazara da kanka domin yankin aikin quadratic don kada ƙima ɗaya ta bayyana sau biyu, sannan tabbatar da cewa yankin aikin juyawa shi ne kewayon aikin asali.
z-m-40-01.material: Ka yi la'akari da aikin f(x) = x² − 2x (karanta: 'x murabba'i cire 2x'). Ba a zaɓi yankin ba tukuna. Faɗin cewa f yana da aikin juyawa a wani saiti yana nufin babu x biyu daban-daban a wannan saitin da ke ba da ƙimar f iri ɗaya (sannan kewayon f ya zama yankin aikin juyawa). Seojin ya yi jadawalin da f(x) yake −1, 0, 3, 8 idan x = 1, 2, 3, 4, duk sun bambanta, sannan ya ce, “f yana da aikin juyawa a duk lambobin gaske.”

z-m-40-03.title: Idan ƙa'idojin sun yi kama, shin zane-zanensu ma iri ɗaya ne?
z-m-40-03.topic: Sake rubuta ayyukan rabo da yankunansu: kwatanta zane-zanen (x²−1)/(x−1) da x+1
z-m-40-03.goal: Fahimci cewa domin a kira furuci biyu ayyuka iri ɗaya bayan sauƙaƙawa, yankunansu ma dole ne su zama iri ɗaya; ka bayyana bisa yanayi lokacin da ya dace a zana su a matsayin zane iri ɗaya da lokacin da bai dace ba.
z-m-40-03.material: Akwai ayyuka biyu f(x) = (x² − 1)/(x − 1) da g(x) = x + 1. (Ana karantawa: 'x murabba'i a cire 1, a raba da x a cire 1'.) Idan ba a bayyana yanki dabam ba, za mu ɗauka cewa duk lambobin ainihi da za a iya lissafa furucin ne yankin. Jia ta ce, “Mai ƙididdigar x² − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1) ne, idan aka soke, ya zama x + 1; saboda haka f da g aiki ɗaya ne kuma zane-zanensu iri ɗaya ne.”

z-m-40-06.title: Me ake bukata domin aikin da aka haɗa daga sassa ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya?
z-m-40-06.topic: Sharadin parameter domin aikin da aka ayyana bisa sassa ya zama ɗaya-da-ɗaya, da bambancinsa da bijection.
z-m-40-06.goal: Fahimci cewa aikin da aka ayyana bisa sassa ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne kawai idan zangon ƙimomin da sassan biyu suka samar ba sa haɗuwa, sannan ka bambanta ɗaya-da-ɗaya da bijection (zangon ƙima ya zama dukkan codomain) ta amfani da zangon a.
z-m-40-06.material: Akwai aikin f(x) = x + 2 (x < 1), f(x) = ax − 1 (x ≥ 1). (a constant ne. Karanta: idan x ya yi ƙasa da 1, “x ƙara 2”; idan x ya kai 1 ko ya fi, “a x a cire 1”.) “Ɗaya-da-ɗaya” yana nufin babu x biyu dabam-dabam da suke ba da ƙimar aikin iri ɗaya; “bijection” kuwa wannan ne tare da zangon ƙimar ya yi daidai da codomain (dukkan lambobin ainihi). Yankin ma’ana da codomain dukkan lambobin ainihi ne.

z-m-40-06.prereq.0: Matakin H3 yana nuna wahala ne kawai a wannan rabon aikin, ba yana nufin tsarin karatu ya sanya wannan abun cikin a wani aji ba. Zato: ka riga ka koyi ma’anar aiki, ma’anonin ayyukan ɗaya-da-ɗaya da bijection, da lissafin ƙimomin ayyukan da aka ayyana bisa sassa.

z-m-40-06.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne da ya yanke hukuncin ɗaya-da-ɗaya daga samun ƙima ɗaya mai girma. Duba ko akwai wurin da aka samu ƙima iri ɗaya sau biyu.

z-m-40-06.s.s3.r.c: Wannan tunani ne cewa ya wadatar ɓangaren dama kawai ya zama mai ƙaruwa. Bincika ko yana haɗuwa da ƙimomin ɓangaren hagu.

z-m-40-06.s.s3.explain: Bijection yana bukatar zangon ƙimar ya zama dukkan lambobin ainihi, saboda haka babu ƙima da za ta ɓace. Ɓangaren hagu yana samar da kowace ƙima da ta yi ƙasa da 3, ɓangaren dama kuma yana samar da kowace ƙima da ta kai a − 1 ko ta fi. Domin kada su haɗu kuma kada a sami gibi tsakaninsu, a − 1 = 3, wato a = 4. Idan a > 4, ƙimomin tsakanin 3 da a − 1 babu su; saboda haka aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne amma ba bijection ba.

z-m-40-09.title: Da ƙauyuka biyu da kuma ƙauyuka uku, ina ya kamata tashar bas ta kasance?
z-m-40-09.topic: Jimillar ayyukan absolute value: zanen layin karye na jimillar tazara S(x) da inda take mafi ƙanƙanta.
z-m-40-09.goal: Fahimci cewa jimillar tazara zuwa ƙauyuka biyu tana da ƙasan shimfiɗe, don haka wuraren ƙaramin ƙima suna da yawa; tabbatar da cewa ga ƙauyuka uku wurin ƙaramin ƙima guda ɗaya ne, sannan ka yi hasashen yanayin ƙauyuka huɗu da kanka.
z-m-40-09.material: A kan hanya madaidaiciya, ana bayyana wurare da x km. Ƙauyen A yana x = 2, ƙauyen B kuma x = 6. Muna son gina tashar bas guda ɗaya a wurin x a hanyar. Idan jimillar tazarar daga tashar zuwa kowane ƙauye ita ce S(x), to S(x) = |x − 2| + |x − 6|. (Karanta: 'absolute value na x cire 2, da absolute value na x cire 6'.) Ana iya gina tashar ko'ina a kan hanyar.
z-m-40-09.thinking.0: Yi hasashe da fahimta inda ƙaramin ƙima yake, sannan ka tabbatar ta lissafi.
z-m-40-09.thinking.1: Nemo wurare da dama da suka cika sharadi.
z-m-40-09.thinking.2: Yi hasashen ƙa'ida idan yawan ƙauyuka ya canza.
z-m-40-09.prereq.0: Matsayin H3 da aka sanya lakabin wahala ne kawai a wannan rarrabawar samarwa, kuma ba ya nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan abun cikin wani aji na musamman. Zato: ka riga ka san cewa absolute value |x − p| shi ne tazara tsakanin x da p a kan layin lambobi.
z-m-40-09.prereq.1: Lissafa ƙimar furuci na layi mai absolute value.
z-m-40-09.prereq.2: Wurare da tazara a layin lambobi.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.prompt: Wane siffa saitin duk wuraren x na tashar da S(x) ya fi ƙanƙanta zai samu?
z-m-40-09.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafa S(x) a x = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 sannan ka rubuta su a jadawali.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.hint.1: Duba yawan x da ke ba da ƙaramin ƙimar S da zangon da waɗannan x suke ciki.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.o.a: x = 2 ko x = 6, wato dai-dai wuraren ƙauyukan kawai.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa dole ne a gina tashar a ƙauye domin ta fi kusa.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ne cewa tsakiyar kawai ta dace.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne cewa tsakanin ƙauyukan biyu jimillar tazara ba ta canzawa.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa maki guda ɗaya a tsakiyar ƙauyukan biyu ne ya fi kyau.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.explain: Idan x yana tsakanin 2 da 6, S(x) = (x − 2) + (6 − x) = 4, wato ba ya canzawa. Idan ya fita waje, yana ƙaruwa. Saboda haka zanen S(x) yana da ƙasan shimfiɗe ga 2 ≤ x ≤ 6.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.prompt: Ƙauye C (x = 10) ya ƙara bayyana. Yanzu S₃(x) = |x − 2| + |x − 6| + |x − 10|. Nemo wurare x guda 3 na lambobi cikakku na tashar inda jimillar tazara zuwa ƙauyuka uku ta kai 10 ko ƙasa da haka. (−5 ≤ x ≤ 15)
z-m-40-09.s.s2.hint.0: Saka ƙima ɗaya a x, nemo tazara uku dabam-dabam, sannan ka haɗa su.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.hint.1: Canja ƙimomin, ka takaita inda iyakokin suke, a ɓangaren da jimillar ta fi 10 (hagu da dama).
z-m-40-09.s.s2.ok.c1: x lamba cikakkiya ce daga −5 zuwa 15.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne x ya zama lamba cikakkiya daga −5 zuwa 15.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Jimillar tazara zuwa ƙauyuka uku ta kai 10 ko ƙasa da haka.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar tazara zuwa ƙauyuka uku ta fi 10. Ka nemo tazara ukun dabam-dabam ka sake haɗa su.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.explain: Mafi ƙarancin S₃(x) shi ne 8 a ƙauyen tsakiya x = 6, kuma yana ƙaruwa yayin da ka matsa kowane gefe. Ƙimomin da ba su fi 10 ba su ne 4 ≤ x ≤ 8. Ba kamar yanayin ƙauyuka biyu ba, babu ƙasan shimfiɗe, kuma wurin ƙaramin ƙima shi ne wuri guda 6.
z-m-40-09.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana yadda wurin da jimillar tazara ta fi ƙanƙanta ya bambanta tsakanin ƙauyuka 2 (2, 6) da 3 (2, 6, 10), sannan ka rubuta hasashenka game da ƙauyuka 4 (2, 6, 10, 14).
z-m-40-09.s.s3.hint.0: Idan akwai ƙauyuka 4, lissafa S₄(x) a wasu x da ke kusa da tsakiya, sannan ka kwatanta su.
z-m-40-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙirga yawan ƙauyukan tsakiya idan akwai ƙauyuka 2 da kuma idan akwai 3.
z-m-40-09.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Ga ƙauyuka 2, ..., ga 3, ..., saboda haka ga 4 ...

Ga ƙauyuka 3, a ƙauyen tsakiya 6 kawai jimillar ce mafi ƙanƙanta, wato 8, don haka wuri guda ne. z-m-40-09.s.s3.model.1: Ga ƙauyuka 2 (2, 6), akwai ƙasan shimfiɗe, don haka ko'ina daga 2 zuwa 6 ya dace; ga ƙauyuka 3 (2, 6, 10), ƙauyen tsakiya 6 ne kaɗai mafi ƙanƙanta. Ga ƙauyuka 4 (2, 6, 10, 14), na yi hasashen cewa duk tazarar tsakanin ƙauyuka biyu na tsakiya za ta sake zama wurin ƙaramin ƙima.

z-m-40-10.title: Idan ƙimomin jadawali sun yi daidai a hagu da dama, shin zanen ma yana daidaito?
z-m-40-10.topic: Daidaiton zanen aiki game da axis y: ƙarfin hujjar cewa wasu ma'auratan ƙimomi sun yi daidai, da gina misalan karyatawa.
z-m-40-10.goal: Bisa ma'anar daidaito game da axis y (f(−x) = f(x) ga duk x), fahimci cewa jadawalin da ke nuna wasu ma'auratan ƙimomi sun yi daidai ba zai tabbatar da daidaito ba; ƙirƙiri da kanka misalin karyatawa daga aikin da ya dace da jadawalin daidai amma ba shi da daidaito.
z-m-40-10.material: Ba a san dabarar aikin f ba, kuma akwai jadawali mai ƙimomi ga wasu x kaɗan kawai. Idan x su ne −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, ƙimomin f(x) su ne 4, 1, 0, 1, 4. Ba a san ƙimomin x da ba sa cikin jadawalin ba. Yankin duk lambobin gaske ne, kuma “daidaito game da axis y” yana nufin f(−x) = f(x) ya tabbata ga duk lambobin gaske x. Jiho ya ce, “A jadawalin ƙimomin x da −x sun yi daidai, don haka zanen f yana daidaito game da axis y.”
z-m-40-10.thinking.0: Yin tunani kan iyakar da hujja mai iyaka za ta iya kaiwa.
z-m-40-10.thinking.1: Bambanta dalilan da ke tabbatar da “ga duk x”.
z-m-40-10.thinking.2: Gina misalin karyatawa da ya dace da jadawalin.
z-m-40-10.prereq.0: Matsayin H3 da aka sanya lakabin wahala ne kawai a wannan rarrabawar samarwa, kuma ba ya nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan abun cikin wani aji na musamman. Zato: ka riga ka san ma'anar daidaito game da axis y (idan maki (x, y) yana nan, to (−x, y) ma yana nan) da yadda ake lissafa ƙimomin polynomial.
z-m-40-10.prereq.1: Saka ƙimomi cikin polynomial x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) sannan ka lissafa.
z-m-40-10.prereq.2: Fahimtar cewa maye gurbin x da −x yana canja alamar kalmomin da suke da matakin iko mara-cikakkiya.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.hint.0: Rarrabe x da ke cikin jadawalin da waɗanda ba sa ciki, sannan ka duba ko za a iya kwatanta f(−x) da f(x) ga kowanne.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin iyakar abin da jimlar “ga duk lambobin gaske x” ta shafa a jadawalin.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.a: A x = ±1, ±2, f(−x) = f(x), kuma ba mu san sauran ba.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne da ya bambanta ma'auratan da aka duba da ƙimomin da ba a duba ba.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.b: Ma'aurata biyun da aka duba a jadawalin duk sun yi daidai, don haka an tabbatar da cewa zanen yana daidaito game da axis y.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani yana miƙa wasu ma'aurata da aka duba zuwa duk x. “Ga duk x” ya haɗa da x da ba sa cikin jadawalin.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma'aurata biyu ne kawai, don haka ba za a iya cewa komai daga wannan jadawalin ba.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani yana watsar da ko da gaskiyar cewa ya yi daidai ga ma'auratan biyun da aka duba. Sake karanta ainihin abin da jadawalin yake nunawa.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma'auratan biyun sun yi daidai, saboda haka da alama yana daidaito, kuma kusan an tabbatar.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani yana ɗaukar ƙarin adadin ma'auratan da aka duba a matsayin hujja. Gwaje-gwaje masu iyaka ba za su iya kawar da misalin karyatawa ba.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.explain: Jadawalin ya nuna cewa f(−x) = f(x) ne kawai a x = ±1, ±2. Ba a san abin da ke faruwa ga x da ba sa cikin jadawalin ba, don haka ba za mu iya tabbatar da daidaiton zanen game da axis y ba.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.prompt: Wane irin dalili ake buƙata domin tabbatar da cewa zanen yana daidaito game da axis y?
z-m-40-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kwatanta ko x guda ɗaya ya isa a nuna misalin karyatawa cewa ba ya daidaito, da kuma x nawa ake buƙata a tabbatar da daidaito.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta yawan dalilan da ake buƙata wajen tabbatar da “ga duk” da wajen karyata shi.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.a: Idan kuma muka rubuta ƙimomin x = ±3, ±4, ±5 a jadawalin kuma duk sun yi daidai, an tabbatar da daidaito.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.a: Wannan tunani ne cewa ƙarin maki yana tabbatar da dukan aikin. Ko da an duba ƙarin adadi mai iyaka, misalin karyatawa na iya kasancewa a wajen jadawalin.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.b: Idan aka zana maki da yawa aka haɗa su, siffar tana kama da kusan daidaito a hagu da dama.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.b: Wannan tunani yana amfani da abin da ido ya gani a matsayin hujja. Ƙimomi masu ɗan bambanci ba sa bayyana a hoto.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.c: Idan an ba da dabara, lissafa f(−x) sannan ka nuna cewa furucin da aka samu iri ɗaya ne da f(x).
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunani ne da ke nuna gaskiyarsa ga harafin x, yana warware “duk x” lokaci guda.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.d: Idan rabon ma'auratan jadawali da suka yi daidai ya kai rabin ko fiye, an tabbatar da daidaito.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.d: Wannan tunani ne da ke yanke hukunci ga “duk x” bisa ma'aunin kaso. Idan ko ɗaya bai cika ba, ba ya daidaito.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.explain: Domin tabbatar da “f(−x) = f(x) ga duk x,” dole ne a nuna hakan da dabara mai harafin x ko a yi magana kan duk x ta wata hanya. Duba ƙarin maki a jadawali na iya ƙara tabbaci, amma ba ya tabbatarwa.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.prompt: Ayyukan g(x) = x² + c·x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) (c ƙayyadadden lamba ce) suna cika ƙimomin jadawali daidai a x = 0, ±1, ±2 (0; 1, 1; 4, 4) (ka tabbatar ta hanyar saka ƙimomin da kanka). Gina hujja cewa wasu daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan ba su daidaito ba: zaɓi lambar cikakkiya c marar sifili (−3 ≤ c ≤ 3) da lamba mai kyau t ta yadda g(t) ≠ g(−t), sannan nemo (c, t) 2 daban-daban.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.0: Daidaita c da t ɗaya, lissafa g(t) da g(−t) dabam, sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta abin da ke faruwa idan ka saka t a matsayin ƙima a cikin jadawali (1, 2) da kuma a matsayin ƙimar da ba ta cikin jadawali (kamar 3).
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c1: c cikakkiyar lamba ce marar sifili daga −3 zuwa 3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c1: Dole ne c ya zama cikakkiyar lamba marar sifili daga −3 zuwa 3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Dole ne t ya zama lamba mai kyau.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c3: g(t) da g(−t) sun bambanta. Wannan shaida ce cewa zanen ba ya daidaita bisa axis y.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Ga wannan t, g(t) da g(−t) iri ɗaya ne. Ko dai ƙima ce a jadawali ko kuma ƙima ce da sakamakonsu ya yi daidai. Gwada wani t.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.explain: x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) 0 ne idan x = 0, ±1, ±2, saboda haka ƙimomin jadawalin ba sa canjawa; amma idan aka maye gurbin x da −x, alamar tana juye. Don haka idan t ba 1 ko 2 ba ne, bambancin g(t) da g(−t) shi ne ninkin 2c·t(t² − 1)(t² − 4). Wannan misali ne da ke karya da'awar cewa ƙimomin jadawali biyar kaɗai za su iya tabbatar da daidaiton zanen.
